content: 2026 consensus: split server state and client state into different tools rather than one global store. TanStack Query owns ALL server state (fetched API data, caching, invalidation) unconditionally; Zustand (486B gzipped) owns small pieces of client-only UI state (sidebar open, active filters, wizard step) the two layers don't need to know about each other. Redux Toolkit is only justified for very large teams needing strict conventions/time-travel debugging; adoption has fallen from 57% to 38% in favor of Zustand for new projects.
